primary_content.text: Maria is the co-founder of Nerd Nomads. She's explored more than thirty counties and been a full time traveler since 2018.
Travel writer and co-founder of Nerd Nomads.

Are you thinking about traveling to Bang Tao Beach in Phuket, Thailand? Then you have come to the right place! Here is a complete travel guide to Bang Tao with everything you need to know about Bang Tao beach – what to do, where to eat, and where to stay in Bang Tao.

We have walked for hours when we finally reach the end of the stunning white sandy Bang Tao Beach. We lay down on the soft, warm sand, in the shadows of the palm trees swaying softly in the breeze. A handful of local kids are playing in the azure blue water. A runner just passed us, other than that, we are entirely alone. The only sound is from the waves rolling on the sand.
Bang Tao Beach is the closest Phuket gets to what we consider to be the perfect tropical beach paradise. Among all the beaches we visited and stayed at in Phuket, Bang Tao Beach is our favorite.
This is our travel guide to Bang Tao Beach in Phuket with everything you need to know before you go.
I can’t agree with you more about Bangtao beach. In fact, when I was there last month, I bought a home there. I can’t wait to move, unfortunately not until the summer 2023.
Wow, lucky you who have bought a home in Bangtao! Congrats! It is my favorite place in Phuket, and I’m sure living there will be amazing. Good luck with the move next summer!

I found your report accidently. This was a great reading, thanks! Could you please give some examples regarding prices, especially taxis (TUI will charge for busstransfer to the hotel 584 SEK for two persons for both ways). I wounder too if You have a report about Ko Samui? Thanks!
Thank you so much! Great to hear that you are going to Bang Tao! It is one of our favorite beaches in Phuket, I’m sure you will love it.
The taxis are pretty expensive in Phuket, at least compared to other parts of Thailand like Bangkok.

A taxi from Phuket Airport to Bang Tao costs about 600-700 Baht = US$16-19 = 180-200 SEK one way. So about 400 SEK both ways from/ to the airport and Bang Tao. This means that you will probably save about 150-200 SEK by taking a taxi compared to the bus transfer by TUI. And you will have the car for yourself, and don’t have to share with a bunch of other tourists, so you can stop along the way if you want to grab some food or something to drink. It takes about 30 min to drive from the airport to Bang Tao.

Sorry, we don’t have any articles about Ko Samui at the moment. But we just returned back home to Norway from Ko Samui. We spent four weeks traveling around Ko Samui and the neighboring island Ko Phangan, so articles about these two islands will be on our blog as soon as possible! 🙂
Have a fantastic trip to Phuket and Samui!
There are no sun beds or umbrellas, or places to eat or drink on Bangtao beach as of Nov27 th, 2022

Oh no! Yeah, it happens once in a while. The Phuket government/ police remove all the sunbeds and umbrellas, but they usually pop up again soon. Strange that there are no places to eat or drink, especially now that it is high season in Phuket.

We last visited Bang Tao Beach in March 2022 and had some great and tasty Thai food at a cozy beach restaurant called Tom Yam Goong, just next to Dusit Thani Laguna Hotel. It was run by a sweet Thai family. We also had drinks and a light lunch (satay) at Club 22 Beach Bar, which is a great place to hang out. Xana Beach Club is also a fancy bar with a big swimming pool, sunbeds, and umbrellas.

Further south along the beach (south of the laguna), there are also a lot of beach restaurants and bars. And, of course, all the beachfront hotels have restaurants and bars. I can’t believe they are all closed down?
Have a great time in Bang Tao!
Thanks for all of your ideas and information. Do you know as we are planning to travel in August if all of the beach restaurants stay open year round?
Thank you so much! Yes, I think the beach restaurants in Bang Tao are open all year round, also in August. But we have never been to Phuket in August, so I don’t know for sure.
But you will have no problem finding places to eat in Bang Tao, as all the hotels along the beach have excellent restaurants. Boat Avenue also has lots of nice restaurants.
Have a fantastic trip to Phuket in August!
l have just found your post for Bang-Tao and found it very informative, thank you!
l am travelling there in October 2023 and staying at the Banyan-Tree and can’t wait to return to Thailand again for our 5th visit to Thailand.
l am looking for a tailor for some shorts/shirt for me and a dress for my wife, would you know of any at are close by that offer a good quality service?
Thank you so much! Great to hear that you will visit Thailand and that you have picked Banyan Tree Hotel in Bang Tao for your stay. It is a fantastic hotel and a lovely beach!

Sorry, we have not been to a tailor in Phuket yet, only in Bangkok. So I don’t know any tailors in this area. I’m sure there are some in Bang Tao, though. Maybe you can ask at the hotel, they can probably recommend some.
Have a fantastic trip to Phuket!
Is there a town nearby, greetings Annette
Yes, there is a shopping area/ small town in Bang Tao. It is called Boat Avenue and has restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, pharmacy, wine shop, and a big supermarket/ grocery shop called Villa Market.
There are two bigger towns on Phuket Island: Phuket Old Town (a 1-hour drive from Bang Tao one way) and Patong (a 45-min drive from Bang Tao one way). You can see them on this Google Maps.

urls.anchor_text: see them on this Google Maps

primary_content.text: Stayed at Dusit Thani 5 years ago but thinking of staying at Banyan Tree this time. Worried it’s a bit far from beach restaurants. To get my bearings, how long is the walk between Banyan Tree and Dusit Thani along the beach?

Both Dusit Thani and Banyan Tree are fantastic 5-star hotels. But nothing beats Dusit Thani’s great location right on the beach. It takes about 5-min to walk from Banyan Tree to the beach. Although Bang Tao Beach is a public beach, Banyan Tree has a private area on the beach with sunbeds.

I will say that it takes about 15-20 min to walk between these two hotels along the beach. There are in general not that many beach restaurants in this area. We ate at the beach restaurant Tom Yam Goong several times, which was really nice, located close to Dusit Thani. Most restaurants are in the Boat Avenue area of Bang Tao. It takes about 40 min to walk from Banyan Tree to Boat Avenue, while it takes about 30 min to walk from Dusit Thani to Boat Avenue.
Have a fantastic trip to Phuket and Bang Tao!
Is the Black Cat restaurant still open in cherntalay please ?
I think they are, but you can message them on Facebook or send them an email and ask for their opening hours:
Great site, it has really helped us to decide which part of Phuket to base ourselves in!
Thank you so much, Angelique! Have a fantastic trip to Phuket!

We are going in Phuket next month and i wasn’t sure where to stay. After your post we decided to stay on Bang Tao beach . What are you think about The Pavillion villa? We are family with 2 teenagers. I did research and is 40 min from Phuket old town . Do you think is good idea to stay there?
Bang Bao is an excellent choice! Such a beautiful and long beach, our favorite on Phuket. The Pavillions is a great choice, the hotel gets excellent reviews.

The only negative is that it is a bit far from the beach. Too far to walk in the sun and heat (30 minutes one way). But the hotel provides free shuttle to/ from the beach, and you can always book a taxi through the Grab app.

There are a lot of top-end resorts in Bang Tao, but The Pavilion stands out. This is a “private hilltop villa with your own swimming pool” type luxury and a perfect tranquil hideaway for that special occasion. The villas are large, with modern Japanese-inspired decor and an infinity pool with an ocean view.

The hotel restaurant, The Plantation Club, is regarded as one of Thailand’s best, and the 360 bar has some of Phuket’s finest sunset views. Golf buggies take you around the property, and there is a free shuttle to the beach (a 5-min ride) and to Tinlay Village for shopping and restaurants.
Have a fantastic trip to Phuket!
Great job on giving us such good information if Bang Tao
I am going there in July this year and need to know how do I travel at night to Phuket old town & back

Thank you so much! I recommend using the app Grab or Bolt when booking a car to Phuket old town and back. Bolt is usually cheaper, but you can check both and compare them. It is about a 45 minute drive from Bang Tao Beach to Phuket Old Town (one way). Or you can ask at your hotel and have them call a taxi for you. You can arrange for the taxi driver to wait for you and take you back to Bang Tao when you are finished in Phuket Old Town.
Have a great trip to Bang Tao in July!

main_topic.h_title: A Brief History Of Bang Tao Beach
main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: It is hard to believe that the Bang Tao area once looked like a war had raged here. Thirty years ago, the beautiful park, lagoon, and beach area that you see today in Bang Tao was a desolate, ruined landscape.

The Bang Tao area used to be one of the most productive tin mines in Thailand and from here came much of Phuket's wealth. But in the 70s, when the prices of tin and rubber dropped dramatically, they closed down the mines and left the area looking like a total mess.

Bang Tao desperately needed new workplaces and new sources of income, and so the idea of transforming Bang Tao into a holiday destination occurred to some developers and investors from Singapore. The Bang Tao beach itself was still beautiful and untouched. But the mine pits had ruined the land surrounding it and polluted and poisoned the rivers and canals.

The work took several years, but slowly, the area came back to life. The old tin mines turned into beautiful lagoons and park areas, linked by narrow canals. Today Bang Tao is a stunning area and a fantastic place to go on a beach holiday.

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: Bang Thao Beach (or Bangtao Beach) is one of the longest beaches on Phuket Island in Southern Thailand.

Located on the island's west coast this half-moon-shaped bay stretches on for 8km of soft white sand. Forest and trees enclave the beautiful Bang Tao Beach, and you can not even see the road nor hear the traffic.

It is a peaceful and relaxed beach. Unlike some of the other beaches in Phuket, Bang Tao Beach is not packed with sunbeds and umbrellas, noisy jet skis, banana boats, water activities, or pushy sellers. Bang Tao Beach is all about finding that zen moment and enjoy some peace while at the same time have access to some of the best hotels, restaurants, and cafes in Phuket.

Bang Tao is considered one of Phuket's more “high-end” holiday destinations, and there are certainly plenty of luxury resorts and top-notch restaurants. However, there are also some excellent mid-range hotels and some cool hostels at the southern end of the beach.

Phuket has a lot of beaches, all different, and decided where to stay can feel a bit overwhelming. If you’re still not sure where is right for you, have a look at our new guide to the best beaches and places to stay in Phuket. That article will give you an overview of Phuket’s areas and the pros and cons of staying at each one, along with our recommendations for hotels.

urls.anchor_text: beaches and places to stay in Phuket

primary_content.text: Bangtao Beach has a lot to offer for just about anyone. Bang Tao beach can be divided into two – the northern part and the southern part.

The northern part of the beach is quiet and pristine. Here you can find your undisturbed slice of paradise, put down your towel, and let the days go peacefully by. Further south you have a great choice of restaurants, shopping, bars, and beach clubs.

main_topic.h_title: Southern Bang Tao Beach – Laguna Phuket Complex
main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: At the southern part of Bang Tao Beach, there is a myriad of freshwater lagoons and canals between the beach and the road, covering 1000 acres of beautifully landscaped park. Here you will find some lovely five- and four-star, resorts, and hotels (7 in total) called the Laguna Phuket Complex. These are top-end hotels offering everything you could want for a holiday- big pools, nice bars, top-notch restaurants, gyms, sports facilities, and children's clubs.
It is easy to go between the hotels, restaurants, and shopping, as you can jump on the free ferry to go across the lake to the different hotels and the beach.
There are also some residential villas and apartment complexes in Bang Tao where you can rent long-term apartments.

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: The northern part of Bang Tao Beach is much less developed and more of a natural kind of beach.

Here the locals enjoy themselves on Sunday afternoon, having barbeques while the children play in the water. The peaceful bliss at this part of Bang Tao Beach is so far from Patong Beach as you can get.
The northernmost curve of Bang Tao Beach merges with the beautiful Layan Beach and Gata Island.

main_topic.h_title: What To Do In Bang Tao Beach – The 7 Top Things
main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: Map of Bang Tao Beach with our recommended Bang Tao hotels and things to do

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: The main attraction of Bang Tao is, of course, Bang Tao Beach itself. It is perfect for walking or running, and you can in total do an 8 km run or walk from one end of the beach to the other.
If you go north, the beach gets more and more peaceful and pristine the further north you get.
I loved going for a stroll along Bang Tao Beach
The long Bang Tao beach is the perfect place to go for a run

Grab your camera/ phone and go for a stroll and explore the beach area of Bang Tao. Buy a fresh coconut or a drink at one of the beach bars and restaurants in the southern part of the beach and enjoy the sunset.

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: Beach clubs are popular in Phuket, and Bang Tao is no exception. Here you can rent lounges, sunbeds, use the pools, and buy food and drinks all day long. In the evenings, you can enjoy a drink or two while enjoying the sunset. The beach clubs are the place to go partying in Bang Tao as they have live DJs spinning records that get the party started.
However, you have to pay to get into the beach clubs, and they are rather expensive.
There are four beach clubs at Bang Tao beach:
Catch Beach Club – the first and most famous of the beach clubs in Bang Tao
Xana Beach Club – at Angsana Laguna Phuket hotel
Dream Beach Club – at the north part of Bang Tao beach

secondary_content.text: Blue Siam Beach Club – at the south part of Bang Tao beach

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: Markets are a big thing in Thailand, and Bang Tao has a great night market. Here you can enjoy some delicious Thai food, snacks, and drinks, and go shopping for souvenirs, clothes, gifts, as well as fresh fruits and vegetables. The prices are reasonable, and the market has a great variety of different goods and food. Worth a visit.

When : Bang Tao Night Market is open every Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday from around 14:00 (2 pm) – 20:00 (8 pm). It is, however, a bit empty in the early afternoon. People tend to come to the market at around 17:00 (5 pm).
Where : The Bang Tao Night Market is located on Soi Bang Thao 2

main_topic.h_title: 4. Lots Of Sports Activities In Bang Tao
main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: Many different sports activities are on the list of what to do in Bang Tao Beach:
Kayaking/ Sailing
At the big lagoon, you can rent kayaks and canoes and go paddling on the lagoon. Or you can rent small sailboats, perfect for practicing your sailing on a windy day.

Bang Tao is perfect for exploring on a bicycle as it has little traffic, and there are many roads to explore. Many of the hotels have bicycles for rent (or for free), or you can rent high-quality bicycles (including e-bikes) at one of the bike rental shops in Bang Tao, like the Siam Bike Tours & Road Bike Rentals (located in Boat Avenue) or Ridenow Phuket.

urls.anchor_text: Siam Bike Tours & Road Bike Rentals

primary_content.text: You can go horseriding along the beach of Bang Tao by contacting Phuket International Horse Club which is located in Bang Tao.

Golf is a big thing in Bang Tao, and there are several golf courses in the area. You can go golfing at the 18-hole golf course Laguna Golf Phuket, or the 27-hole golf course at Phuket Country Club. There is also a Phuket Golf Center in Bang Tao with a golf school and lots of fun activities for families and kids.
Mini Golf
If golf is not your thing, mini golf might be. Great fun both for adults and kids! Head to the 18 holes Adventure Mini Golf in Bang Tao Beach. They also have a restaurant and bar.

urls.anchor_text: Adventure Mini Golf in Bang Tao Beach

primary_content.text: Muay Thai Training/ Yoga
Bang Tao has a Muay Thai gym, the Sitsongpeenong, where you can work off those calories or take a boxing or yoga lesson. You can even join a Muay Thai training course over several weeks and months.
Diving/ Snorkeling
There are several diving centers in Bang Tao where you can book diving tours or snorkeling tours.

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: Relax and wind down at one of the many quality luxurious spas in the Laguna area of Bang Tao. Here you can get massages, facial treatments, manicures, and pedicures. Many of the hotels have spas, but there are also several independent spas.
If you want to splurge and get a real luxury spa treatment, you should head to the spa at Banyan Tree Spa Sanctuary, world-famous for its massages and body treatments.

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: If you want a break from sunbathing and relaxing on the beach, you can visit the small but beautiful Buddhist temple Wat Choeng Thale.
The temple is not that big, but it is gorgeous with its bright white and red colors and gold decorations.

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: I must admit that I am always skeptical about parks and tours that include wild animals as you never know if the animals are well looked after or if it is just a setup to make money from tourists. I am against riding elephants, so please, whatever activities you choose to participate in and book in Phuket, do NOT go on any elephant rides!
Here are several elephant sanctuary parks in the Bang Tao area, located close to each other in the forest and jungle area inland (a 15-min drive from Bang Tao Beach).

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: At the Elephant Wildlife Sanctuary, the elephants roam around freely in a huge jungle area. There is no elephant riding at the sanctuary. Here you get to see and cuddle with the cute elephants, feed them, and go bathing with the elephants in a river (a bit muddy). Great fun!
This Elephant Save & Care program is a small-group tour that takes about four hours. You will be picked up from your hotel and served lunch at the park.
There are two time slots to choose from:

primary_content.text: The Elephant Retirement Park in Bang Tao in Phuket does not do elephant riding, nor do they chain or beat the elephants. The park is enormous, and the elephants roam free.
At the elephant park, you get to meet the elephants upfront, feed them, and even bathe with them in the river and the mud. The park has two sessions each day when you can visit; each lasts 3,5 hours:
Morning session: 08:30 (8:30 am) – 12:00 (12 pm)
Afternoon session: 13:00 (1 pm) – 16:30 (4:30 pm)

Included in the elephant park visit are a round-trip hotel pick-up, lunch buffet, and a t-shirt. You also get to shower at the park after your visit, as you might get muddy after bathing with the elephants. 🙂
It seems like the elephants are loved and well looked after, and the park gets good reviews on TripAdvisor.
Where : 392/5 Thanon Bandon-Cherngtalay, Bang Tao (a 15 min drive from Bang Tao Beach)

main_topic.h_title: Where To Eat In Bang Tao
main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: The restaurants and cafes in Bang Tao are mostly clustered in two areas – Boat Avenue & Tinlay Village, and at the southern Bang Tao Beach.

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: The Boat Avenue and Tinlay Village is an upscale shopping complex/ village near the Laguna Phuket Complex located inland in the Bang Tao area, between the lagoon and the canals. Most hotels have free shuttle buses taking you between your hotel and the shopping and dining areas.

At Boat Avenue and Tinlay Village, you find some of the best international restaurants in the entire Phuket, hip and trendy shops, as well as the supermarket Villa Market (with globally imported food and an impressive wine cellar).

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: And if you are in Bang Tao on a Friday, you must visit the Fun Friday Avenue Market where you can eat a lot of delicious street food, drinks, and snacks, as well as do a little shopping. The small Fun Friday Avenue Market pops up at Boat Avenue every Friday afternoon (16:00 – 22:00). Night markets are an important part of the culture of Thailand and are a real must-do experience when visiting Thailand. Night markets are vibrant, colorful, and great fun.

main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: You will find several small beach restaurants just south of Outrigger Laguna Hotel selling Thai food, but also some western food, at a lower price than at Boat Avenue and Tinlay Village.

The Thai food restaurants here serve some delicious seafood, and the location is beautiful right on the beach. The beach restaurants all look the same with tables made of bamboo on the beach and colorful umbrellas. You will also find a couple of small reggae bars in this area, great for a sunset drink.

main_topic.h_title: Where To Stay In Bang Tao Beach Phuket
main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: We stayed at the Dusit Thani Laguna Resort and loved it. From the moment we stepped into the beautiful open-air Thai-decorated lobby and were greeted warmly with drinks and a wet towel, we felt very welcomed. The lady that did the check-in also showed us around the property and guided us to our room. Such a great service!
The stunning reception at Dusit Thani Laguna Resort Phuket
Our wonderful room at Dusit Thani Laguna Resort with a garden view

Although Dusit Thani Laguna is a stunning 5-star hotel, with an excellent breakfast buffet, big swimming pool, well-equipped gym, and a beautiful garden, it is the location that is the real star of the hotel. Dusit Thani Laguna Resort is located on the best part of Bang Tao Beach.

Many of the rooms have seafront views, and to get to the beach, you walk through the beautiful garden. The hotel has plenty of sunbeds on the beach, so here you can relax and enjoy the beach and sunbathing. You can quickly get to the other hotels, shopping, and dining areas of Bang Tao as the hotel provides free shuttle buses and boats.

The luxurious Movenpick Resort has a sweet location right on the beach. The hotel has 40 spacious and well-equipped apartments, all with private balconies. The sea view villas have a stunning ocean view, and some come with a private pool. Some of the residences have several bedrooms (2 or 3) making them perfect for families with kids.

The hotel has a free shuttle service that takes you to the Boat Avenue shopping and restaurant area. The breakfast buffet is impressive with a great variety, and the onsite restaurant the Palm serves delicious Thai and western food (including in-room dining). Don´t miss the chocolate hour by the pool, and the happy hour. And if you feel that you have overeaten, one option is to head to the hotel gym or hop on one of the hotel bikes and go for a bicycle ride around the Laguna and Bang Tao area.

The Banyan Tree is as luxurious as you can get, close to the beach. There is a free shuttle bus that takes you to the beach where the hotel has some comfortable sunbeds at a beautiful part of the beach. The Thai-styled villas are stunning, with private pools/ jacuzzi, a sunken bathtub with spa toiletries in the bathroom, and a vast living room decorated with pure Thai silks.

Their spa is one of the best in the whole of Thailand, where you can get massage and beauty treatments. Wellness is the focus at this hotel, and you can do yoga classes, Thai boxing, or a mindful practice session. The whole resort oozes of peacefulness, tranquillity, and beauty. The turndown service every evening even offers a surprise gift.
Mid Range

A small quiet and relaxed family-driven hotel with 11 apartments built around two swimming pools. Pai Tan Villas has a great location with only a 5 minutes walk to the southern Bang Tao beach and the restaurants and shopping. It is a good value for your money. They have family apartments too, with two bedrooms. The breakfast is good, especially the pancakes with fresh fruits.

Both my parents and my brother have stayed at the Cassia Phuket Hotel, and they all loved it. Cassia has a beautiful location right by the big lagoon, close to the Bang Tao Beach. You can easily take the shuttle ferry from the hotel right to the beach. Cassia is an apartment hotel with new, big, and comfortable apartments all with a balcony.

A brand new and stylish hotel (opened January 2019) only 100 m (3 min walk) from the southern part of Bang Tao Beach with beachfront restaurants and cafes. All rooms have a balcony, and some have a small kitchen. The patio is super cozy. I love the design of the hotel and the modern decor in the rooms. A great value.

This stylish and clean hostel is located close to Bang Tao Beach (only a 3 min walk to the beach). The shared bathrooms are spotlessly clean and modern, and you can choose between mixed dormitory or female dormitory rooms (bunk beds) which are air-conditioned all day.
The hostel has a lovely garden with hammocks, a pool, and the dormitory rooms have patios.
As the name implies, this is a chilled place perfect for meeting new friends and partying at the Catch Beach Club (only a 3 min walk away from the hostel).

main_topic.h_title: How To Get To Bang Tao Beach
main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: You can quickly get to Phuket by plane as a lot of international airlines fly directly to Phuket International Airport, from both Europe, the USA, Australia, and other places in Asia, and of course from Bangkok.
Getting from the airport to Bang Tao Beach is easiest done by taxi or Grab Car. The drive from the airport takes about 30 min, depending on the traffic.
After a long flight, nothing is better and more convenient than to have a private driver with a comfortable air-con car waiting for you at Phuket Airport and drive you to your hotel.

main_topic.h_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.main_title: The Ultimate Travel Guide To Bang Tao Beach In Phuket
main_topic.author: Nerd Nomads

primary_content.text: If you are looking for a comfortable and high-class stay in Phuket, with the most beautiful and peaceful beach, then Bang Tao Beach is the place. Among all the beaches we have visited and stayed at in Phuket, I must admit that Bang Tao Beach is my favorite beach to stay at in Phuket.

It is relatively close to the airport (only a 30 min drive), Phuket town, and the other highlights of Phuket. And you can easily take a taxi or order a Grab (Thailand answer to Uber) from Bang Tao Beach to get to the more well-known but busier beaches like Patong Beach (a 30 min drive) if you like to check them out.
Hope you enjoyed this travel guide to Bang Tao Beach 🙂 If you have any questions leave a comment below or send us an email!
